title: Data-driven Discovery of Lie Symmetries and First Integrals with Latent ODEs
abstract: arXiv:2610.35967v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present LatentLieODE, a novel neural ODE method to discover linear Lie symmetries and first integrals of the learned dynamics from timeseries observations such as video inputs. It starts with an autoencoder, which learns a low dimensional representation of the observed system and then maps trajectories to decorrelated latent coordinates $z \in \mathbb{R}^d$. A bank of linear infinitesimal generators $\mathbf{A}_k \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times d}$ is fitted jointly against a differentiable Lie-bracket residual $\mathbf{J}_f(z)\mathbf{A}z - \mathbf{A} f(z)$, while an MLP optimises the latent ODE $f(z) = \mathrm{d}z/\mathrm{d}t$ to reconstruct the observation-space timeseries. After suitable generators and $f$ are found, we fit a third network $H_\phi$ to generate the first integral of the system. translated_title: 基于潜变量ODE的李对称性与首次积分的数据驱动发现
translated_abstract: 我们提出了LatentLieODE，这是一种新颖的神经ODE方法，能够从时间序列观测数据（如视频输入）中发现所学动力系统的线性李对称性和首次积分。该方法首先利用自编码器学习观测系统的低维表示，然后将轨迹映射到去相关的潜坐标 $z \in \mathbb{R}^d$。方法通过可微的李括号残差 $\mathbf{J}_f(z)\mathbf{A}z - \mathbf{A} f(z)$ 联合拟合一组线性无穷小生成元 $\mathbf{A}_k \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times d}$，同时用多层感知机（MLP）优化潜变量ODE $f(z) = \mathrm{d}z/\mathrm{d}t$ 以重构观测空间中的时间序列。在找到合适的生成元和 $f$ 之后，我们再拟合第三个网络 $H_\phi$ 来生成系统的首次积分。在六个基准系统（谐振子、单摆与双摆、Lotka-Volterra捕食模型、像素摆、球面测地线）上，我们发现每个系统……
tldr: 提出LatentLieODE方法，结合自编码器与潜变量神经ODE，能直接从视频等时间序列观测数据中自动发现动力系统的线性李对称性与首次积分。
en_tdlr: LatentLieODE is a novel neural ODE framework that automatically discovers linear Lie symmetries and first integrals of learned dynamics directly from timeseries observations such as video inputs, by jointly training an autoencoder, a bank of infinitesimal generators, and a latent dynamics model.
